section_path_text: MMI Daily Iron Ore Index Report September 11 2026
summary:
Main
Iron ore futures were weaker today. The DCE most-traded I2701 contract settled at 718 yuan/mt, down 1.78% from the previous session.Qingdao port spot prices fell 8-13 yuan/mt on average. Traders were reasonably active and mills bought largely to cover immediate needs.
